== Prefix ==

Before we get too much further into this, let's thinkabout it... what are these for? Where should they go? Right now the template assumes they ALL will be sent to Wotwiki:, which may not be true (what about STYLE -> [[Help:Style Guide]]?

I also just realized that making them at NAV, STYLE, CI, etc, just inflates/clutters our article space. On the other hand, making them at Wotwiki:STYLE kind of reduces the point of shortcuts, doesn't it? Wikipedia uses '''WP:ABBR''' I believe, but we don't have an easily memorizable shortcut...'''WW:'''? Bleah - maybe the whole shortcut setup isn't worth the hassle. I'm willing to forgo it...
